name: Packages Protocol
summary:
The packages/protocol module defines the wire protocol between client and server: message schemas validated at runtime, CBOR serialization, and length-prefixed frame decoding/encoding. It provides typed message abstractions (ClientMessage, ServerMessage) built on CBOR with strict validation, plus streaming decoders for framing.

Key design: protocol.ts uses TypeBox schemas to define a strict, versioned message envelope (version 8). Messages are CBOR-encoded; framing.ts adds a 4-byte length prefix (big-endian uint32). codec.ts wraps framing and CBOR with validation/type-checking into a push-based decoder streaming interface. CBOR implementation is self-contained with safety limits (max depth 64, max byte length 16 MiB).

Packages exchange: client sends hello/request/cancel; server sends hello/hello_error/response/service_update/attachment. Validation errors are surfaced as ProtocolValidationError or FrameError during decode. Constants like PROTOCOL_VERSION and DEFAULT_MAX_FRAME_LENGTH live in protocol.ts and framing.ts respectively.

The structured entry points are encodeCbor/decodeCbor (cbor), encodeFrame/FrameDecoder (framing), encodeClientMessage/encodeServerMessage and ClientMessageDecoder/ServerMessageDecoder (codec), and parseClientMessage/parseServerMessage (codec) — the latter produce typed, validated objects from raw decoded values.
keyPoints: Defines a versioned protocol (PROTOCOL_VERSION=8) with strict message schemas in protocol.ts using TypeBox, validated at runtime against a union of client/server message variants (ClientMessage, ServerMessage).
CBOR codec implements full RFC 8949 with safety limits: max depth 64, max byte/container length 16 MiB, configurable via CborOptions; encodeCbor/decodeCbor are the primary entry points.

Framing adds a 4-byte length prefix; FrameDecoder handles incremental push of chunks, produces complete frames, enforces max frame length via FrameDecoderOptions; encodeFrame produces the prefixed bytes.

codec.ts separates concerns: parseClientMessage/parseServerMessage validate raw decoded values; ClientMessageDecoder/ServerMessageDecoder combine framing+CBOR parsing into a streaming API with push/end, raising ProtocolValidationError or FrameError on malformed data.
Test coverage confirms wire compatibility; tests include CBOR known-vector hex strings (e.g., empty array '80', map with a:1,b:[2,3] 'a26161016162820203') and protocol hello messages.
